Miscellaneous 13

1 Failure or delay by either party in exercising or enforcing any right or remedy under this Agreement in whole or in part shall not be deemed a waiver thereof or prevent the subsequent exercise of that or any other rights or remedy

2 CBC and its employees and MediWound and its employees shall at all times be considered as independent contractors of each other, and at no time or under any circumstances shall they be considered employees, representatives, partners or agents of each other

3 This Agreement shall constitute the entire agreement and understanding of the parties relating to the subject matter of this Agreement and supersede all prior oral or written agreements, understandings or arrangements between them relating to such subject, except for the TT Agreement
The MOU shall be deemed so superseded by this Agreement only upon the Effective Date

4 Other than as explicitly amended and marked herein, all applicable terms and conditions of the Agreement as originally executed by the parties shall remain without change and shall continue to be binding and in full force and effect
No change or addition may be made to this Agreement except in writing signed by the duly authorized representatives of both parties
5 The provisions intended by their nature to survive the termination or expiration of this Agreement shall so survive including without limiting Sections 1, 3

Without derogating from the foregoing, it is clarified that the restriction with respect to MediWound’s intellectual property and CBC’s obligations under the TT Agreement as well as MediWound’s exclusive rights under this Agreement (as amended) shall continue to apply and survive the termination or expiration of the Agreement

contract_agreement_summary: CBC and MediWound are independent contractors of each other.
The agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the parties, superseding prior agreements except for the TT Agreement.
All original terms of the executed agreement remain binding unless explicitly amended in writing.
The agreement includes exhibits detailing Bromelain SP specifications and price lists.
MediWound will consider price changes at CBC's request, no more than once every 7 months.
MediWound will make payments for Bromelain SP batches within 45 days of delivery, pending acceptance.
MediWound will make a down payment of USD 12/kg for 15% of the Annual Forecast before Dec. 31 for insurance of components, materials, and capacity maintenance.
Payment can be made directly to CBC or, upon written request, to Golden Life International Co., Ltd., with such payment considered valid fulfillment to CBC.
CBC is responsible for ensuring payments to Golden Life International Co., Ltd. comply with applicable laws and regulations, and bears any related tax implications.
compliance_and_expectations_summary: CBC must ensure its Affiliates and Sub-Contractors comply with the agreement.
Failure to enforce a right or remedy does not waive that right.
CBC and MediWound must maintain their status as independent contractors.
Changes to the agreement require written consent from both parties.
CBC is responsible for tax implications related to payments made to Golden Life International Co., Ltd.
CBC must ensure that payment by MediWound to Golden Life International Co., Ltd. does not violate any applicable laws and regulations.

amount_deliverables_for_shipments.description: Shipments of Bromelain SP batches from CBC to MediWound, with payment terms based on delivery and acceptance.
Down payment made by MediWound to CBC for insurance of components and materials and maintenance of manufacture and supply capacity.

termination_and_expiry_summary: Provisions intended to survive termination or expiration include sections related to intellectual property, CBC's obligations under the TT Agreement, and MediWound's exclusive rights.

The restriction with respect to MediWound’s intellectual property and CBC’s obligations under the TT Agreement as well as MediWound’s exclusive rights under this Agreement shall continue to apply and survive the termination or expiration of the Agreement.
